content.short: Mayan Finance provides a seamless one-click experience for cross-chain swaps, aiming to secure the best swap rate through the Mayan auction protocol.
content.description: Mayan Finance is a cross-chain swap auction protocol spanning Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche, Multichain, Polkadot, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, and Bitcoin. It delivers a seamless one-click experience designed to secure the best available swap rate through the Mayan auction mechanism. As a decentralized on/off-ramp solution, users can move assets across chains without paying gas on the destination chain. On-chain swaps can be affected by bots and MEV, but Mayan lets a bot compete to obtain the best rate while you retain custody of your assets, thanks to the Flash Swap program.
